purpose: R4D-1 evidence for `grapt-service`. QD01-QD17 each name one load-bearing law of the engine-selection receipt, the exact source edit that removes it, and the witness that must turn red once it is gone. Every mutation is applied inside its own disposable git worktree checked out at the exact candidate commit, so no mutant is ever written into the calling worktree.
isolation: Every mutation is applied inside its own disposable git worktree checked out at the exact candidate commit. No mutant is ever written into the calling worktree, so there is no restore step that could leave a stale build behind.
scope_note: `QD` is exclusive to this crate. Four live tokens share the letter Q — `Q` in grapt-runtime, `QA` in grapt-api, `QL` in grapt-location and `QD` here — so the runner selects on a whole-token `re.fullmatch` and `--self-test` proves all four separations. A `str.startswith('Q')` selector would sweep every one of them into a single lane's evidence.

mutations.law: A selection receipt's instant comes from the injected clock, never from a constant or ambient time
A recorded attachment is held by owner IDENTITY, so a reused PID never inherits it
A different owner makes the recorded attachment stale rather than reusable
A differential whose two sides name one owner is one engine measured twice, not a comparison
A differential whose two sides name one engine is not a comparison either
Reverting the selector is total, so the switch is never one-way
A health-only answer is refused as unattributed, by that exact name
An unknown engine label is refused rather than defaulted to an engine
The recorded refusal vocabulary is stable for ALL FOUR labels, so a projection cannot silently change word; every label reaches expected/state.json

The same-selection refusal label is recorded too — the fourth word now reaches a surface rather than none
The real manifest is gated: an upward workspace edge added to this crate is refused
An entry whose identity cannot be established is REFUSED, never assumed to be its own key
The allowlist admits exactly one workspace crate; widening it silently is what the gate exists to stop
The manifest validates against the ACTUAL ratified schema file, whose $schema const is the independent oracle — not a literal restated inside this lane
